notes.title: Linux and Mac ports available now!
notes.notes:
Dear players, 

After short and fruitful Beta Test, we are presenting Linux Wine and Mac Wineskin ports of the game. 

Thank You very much to all players who took part in Beta! 
All reported bugs was fixed, but if You still have problem with Mac or Linux version, please, report it on discussion forum. 
Alt+Tab might produce undesired behavior on some systems, beware. 

[u]Linux[/u]
On Linux, antialising has to be turned off in game launcher.

Thank You and have a good play!  ːsteamhappyː

notes.notes:
Dear players, 

We also changed our activation system to DLM V2 (Digital License Management). Players receives serial keys, but no activation required. 

This might be interesting for people who couldn't activate the game and always had "Demo" version issue.

Thank You and have a good play! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Public Linux and Mac Beta Tests
notes.notes:
Dear players, 

We are starting public Beta tests of Linux and Mac X-Blades Wine ports. 
Everybody who have a copy of the game, can take part in it. 

How To Do 
1)Right Mouse Buttom (RMB) on X-Blades in Your game library. 
2)At the bottom - Properties. 
3)At the top of the new window - BETAS 
4)Enter this code - "xbladestestbetalinux" and click "Check Code" for Linux.
4)Enter this code - "xbladesmacbetatest" and click "Check Code" for Mac.
5)Select the beta "Mac Beta Test" or "Linux Beta Test". 
6)Close window and it should update Your game. 

Fell free to leave any comments or report bug on discussion forum. 
If You haven't noticed bugs, please, leave a small comment including your OS and system specifications. 

Thank You and have a good play!  ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: A Truly Bizarre Metamorphosis. This Female Character Looks Totally Different!
notes.notes:
Newly released Blades of Time is a spiritual successor to X-Blades, a hack-and-slash game noteworthy if only for its risqué Japanese style character design.

Blades of Time is the game's spiritual successor. Kotaku has covered the title before (here), but honestly, this title hasn't been on my radar. At all.

It stars Ayumi, who appeared in X-Blades, but boy, does she ever look different. Gone are the Japanese stylings for a more realistic Western style.

X-Blades was developed by Russia's Gaijin Entertainment in North America in 2009. The studio also developed Blades of Time, but what a difference a few years make.

「Xブレード」 進化の歴史 [アルファルファモザイク]
